findings.title: Missing dedup key was accepted and allowed repeated view registration
findings.trigger: A partial restore or schema change removes post_daily_views' primary key while retaining its table, columns and lifecycle trigger.
findings.before: CheckPostSchema and common C startup accepted the invalid schema. Untargeted ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING still inserted another daily row, and the repeated account/day registration committed.
findings.fix: Validate the exact non-deferrable primary keys on all three feed tables at startup. Explicitly target (account_id,post_id,view_day) in registration so constraint loss after startup fails closed and rolls back.
findings.initialReproduction: FAIL on original eec8f4e implementation; all three missing keys were accepted and a repeated view committed without the daily key.

reviewCoverage.api: Strict request/response allowlists, current Bearer/final Gate, safe headers/errors and legacy DTO compatibility reviewed; real HTTPS and parser regressions passed.
reviewCoverage.migration: 0019 SQL remains unchanged. Fresh 0001..0019 and populated 0018 upgrade, existing post/content/task/channel preservation, Down refusal, restricted role and closure hooks rerun.
reviewCoverage.views: Shanghai midnight, author-account exclusion, retry dedup, two concurrent accounts/12 requests, non-author reads not counting, aggregate failure rollback and post-checkpoint Gate boundaries covered.
reviewCoverage.blocking: Catalog-only complete account set, canonical same-set retries, selected channel/all-blocked/reset and filtering before SQL LIMIT reviewed.
reviewCoverage.pagination: Stable same-time order, initial publication ceiling, scope/account/channel/limit/expiry binding; deletes/hides between pages refill the page, removal of final unread row terminates; preference A-to-B-to-A cannot revive an old cursor.
